ifDeleted.summary: The cold open introduces all four characters, the team's standup format and the AI argument the whole play runs on. It is the first and fullest home of the talking-over-Kristina comedy, and it plants the long-lived keys versus SJ's JWT memo setup that pays off in the s20, s20b and s22 incident. Deleting it orphans the opening lines of both s01b and s01c and removes the setup for the play's climax and for the s25 bookend.
